name: tguserbot-framework
description: A TypeScript MTProto-based Telegram userbot framework with plugin system, command parser, permission control, and SQLite persistence.

scripts.build: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist/gui/web', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.cpSync('src/gui/web', 'dist/gui/web', {recursive: true});"
